title: Codyssey Technology Field Atlas v1
scope: A field-oriented map taxonomy for the canonical glossary. Missions are overlays across these fields, not map owners.

classificationPolicy.primaryField: Each canonical term has one best home field. Existing glossary category is evidence, not the field taxonomy itself.
classificationPolicy.secondaryFields: A term is listed in another field only when that field regularly consumes, exposes, operates, or secures it.
classificationPolicy.mapRole: core is native to its home map; foundation explains a map; boundary hands work to another field; shared is intentionally reused by three or more field contexts.
classificationPolicy.confidence: HIGH means the canonical term and mission evidence agree; MEDIUM means a cross-field or umbrella judgment was needed; LOW means the glossary audit already identifies an unresolved semantic collision.

fields.label: Frontend / Web UI
fields.purpose: Browser UI, web documents, styling, client interaction, and client rendering.

fields.label: Backend / Server / API
fields.purpose: Application servers, server rendering, API boundaries, and service architecture.

fields.label: Data / Database
fields.purpose: Structured data, persistence, query systems, serialization, and data processing.

fields.label: Linux / Operating System / Runtime
fields.purpose: Shells, files, processes, scheduling, resource use, and host operating systems.

fields.label: DevOps / Infrastructure / Cloud
fields.purpose: Containers, cloud resources, deployment, networking operations, and platform delivery.

fields.label: Git / Collaboration / Software Engineering
fields.purpose: Version control, review, branching, repository workflow, and team delivery.

fields.label: Security / Authentication / Authorization
fields.purpose: Identity, credentials, permissions, secrets, transport protection, and access policy.

fields.label: Programming Foundations
fields.purpose: Language constructs, execution, design principles, debugging, and reusable implementation concepts.

fields.label: Algorithms / Data Structures
fields.purpose: Data organization, complexity, traversal, ordering, and search strategies.

fields.label: Network / Web Protocol
fields.purpose: HTTP, TCP, addressing, ports, routing, and application-network boundaries.

fields.label: AI / ML / Computing Hardware
fields.purpose: Model use, prompting, inference, tensors, and accelerator concepts.

fields.label: Developer Workflow / Tools
fields.purpose: Editors, diagnostics, documentation, reports, and project-level developer tooling.
